'''Kala'uun''' was a [[Spaceport|starport]]<ref name="PSF">''[[A New Hope: The Princess, the Scoundrel, and the Farm Boy]]''</ref> on the [[planet]] [[Ryloth]].<ref name="Rebel Files" />

==History==
During the [[Ryloth Insurgency]] following the [[Clone Wars]], [[TriNebulon News]] reported from Kala'uun that [[Cham Syndulla]] of the [[Free Ryloth Movement]] claimed responsibility for the [[Imperial hovertrain attack|explosion of a reservoir]] that washed away an Imperial [[hovertrain]].<ref name="Rebel Files" />

At some point prior to the [[Destruction of Alderaan|destruction]] of the [[planet]] [[Alderaan]], the [[smuggler]] [[Han Solo]] visited Kala'uun and struck up a relationship with a [[Twi'lek]] [[bartender]] named [[Hellene]].<ref name="PSF" />

==Behind the scenes==
Kala'uun was first introduced as a [[city]] on the [[planet]] [[Ryloth]] in "[[Big Quince (short story)|Big Quince]]," a short [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] story written by [[Peter M. Schweighofer]] and released in [[Star Wars Adventure Journal 2|''Star Wars Adventure Journal'' 2]] in [[1994]]. The city's existence, although not its location, were confirmed to be [[canon]] by ''[[A New Hope: The Princess, the Scoundrel, and the Farm Boy]]'', an adaptation of [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']] written by [[Alexandra Bracken]] and released in [[2015]].
